trope_excerpts.limit: Literal keyword candidates contain false positives and miss implicit scope/polarity. Prior narrative report documents album/book/finale mismatches; no automated factual ruling.

requirements: Resolve media type plus stable catalog ID, original/release identity, aliases/remakes and duplicate listings without name-only merges.
Confirm source refers to the same work and distinguish movie/show/season/episode/edition and temporal segment.
Preserve original stored URL, validated canonical URL and namespace; separate malformed prefixes/aliases from source assertions.
Read excerpt for asserted/averted/subverted/referenced/hypothetical application and bind participants/events; a mention is not positive presence.
Record source capture timestamp/hash, independent reviewer judgment and coverage/unknown state.
Independent factual review belongs to corpus/reference ticket; definitions, feature selection and quality gates remain undecided.
